description: Newlines can separate an object type's attributes
notes: The native syntax grammar lets newlines separate object elements, but the prose says newlines between the braces are ignored as whitespace, and prose outranks the grammar (native/collections/object-newline-separated). hashicorp/hcl's parseObjectCons (hclsyntax/parser.go) takes a newline as a separator, and getType (ext/typeexpr/get_type.go) reads the elements with hcl.ExprMap.
